What it does

A few things you might already wish existed.

Auto-formatting cards

Paste any link and we pull the title, description and preview into a card you can move and remix.

Infinite canvas

Pan, zoom, sprawl. No edges, no folders, no cramped sidebar — just space to think out loud.

Real-time multiplayer

Send a link and your team is on the same canvas with you. Cursors, comments and edits — all live.

Paste anything

URLs, images, screenshots, PDFs, plain text. The clipboard is the input box. ⌘V to add.

Brand kits

For studios on Premium: brand each board with custom colors, fonts and surfaces. White-label your client work.

Yours, privately

EU-hosted. Password-protect any board. Set expiring share links. No third-party analytics, ever.

Made for

People with too many tabs.

A place where ideas actually get found again.

Stop pretending your bookmarks app works. Throw the link on a board, drag it next to its cousins, and let the spatial memory do the rest.

Questions

The honest ones.

Nope. Boards can be shared via public link, and visitors don't need an account to view. They'll need one to edit, comment or paste.

On EU servers, under EU privacy law. We use Supabase (Frankfurt region) for the database and storage. We never sell or share your data with third parties.

Pinterest and Are.na imports are on the roadmap for Q3. Notion pages and databases work today — paste any Notion URL and you get a card with the live preview.

Pro is for individuals — unlimited boards, real-time multiplayer with up to 5 collaborators. Premium is for studios — adds custom brand kits, white-label sharing, project workspaces, and up to 20 collaborators per board.

Yes. Cancel from your dashboard. You keep access until the end of the billing period, and your boards stay safe — they just downgrade to the Free tier limits.

Pasteboard is a PWA — install it from your browser and it behaves like a native app, including a system-level paste shortcut. A native macOS app is in beta for Premium users.

Built in Europe

Made in the EU. Hosted there too.

Your boards live on EU servers under EU privacy law. No third-party trackers, no resale of your data, no surprises — just a tool, made by people, in a small place on the map.

CVE-2025-23419.summary:
When multiple server blocks are configured to share the same IP address and port, an attacker can use session resumption to bypass client certificate authentication requirements on these servers. This vulnerability arises when  TLS Session Tickets https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_ssl_module.html#ssl_session_ticket_key  are used and/or the  SSL session cache https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_ssl_module.html#ssl_session_cache  are used in the default server and the default server is performing client certificate authentication.
